verdict.rationale: Skills are plain filesystem artifacts: a SKILL.md directory that Claude picks up automatically, so an agent can 'install' one by writing files. Programmatic paths also exist, including the Skills API for upload and management, Agent SDK loading of plugins from local directories, and the --plugin-dir flag. However, the documented install path for distributed skills is the in-session slash command '/plugin marketplace add' plus '/plugin install', with no evidence it runs headlessly or without prompts. Missing for 10: a documented non-interactive CLI or flag for marketplace/plugin install, an explicit statement that install needs no confirmation prompts, hands-on corroboration of an agent completing an install end to end.
